VDJdb summary

197,637 records over 1,551 publications and 2,068 epitopes. Built from chunks/ by vdjdb summary --interactive. The printed dashboard is the static version; this one is for reading exact values.

Growth by year

Distinct TCR chains, epitopes, MHC alleles and publications first reported at or before each year. Click a chain configuration in the legend to isolate it across all four metrics.

V gene and MHC allele

One heatmap per chain and MHC class, cells with at least 10 records. The colour scale is capped so a few very large cells do not flatten the rest; the hover reports the uncapped count.

CDR3 length

Homo sapiens, both chains.

Epitope length

By MHC class. The hover carries the number of distinct CDR3 behind each bar.

Confidence score

Log record count, by MHC class and chain.
